author: Arnav
problem: Read N and a permutation p of 0..N-1: N people sit around a turntable, and dish p_i is in front of person i. Person i is happy if dish i is in front of person i-1, i or i+1 (mod N). The table may be rotated any number of steps; print the maximum number of happy people.
bug_description: Computes the rotation as p[i]+j-1+i instead of p[i]+j-1-i, adding the seat index where it should subtract it.

comments.accurate: For each dish, tallies the three rotations that bring it next to its owner, then prints the best rotation's count
comments.wrong_behavior: For each dish, counts the owner's seat forward from the dish's spot to get the three rotations, then takes the best one
comments.wrong_location: Rotation formula verified; check the three neighbours wrap around at both ends of the table
